blocks.text: We provide a full range of tests for the concentrations and intensities of harmful factors in accordance with the current Regulation of the Minister of Health. Our analyses allow for a reliable assessment of occupational risk and the provision of safe working conditions.

items: Acoustics and lighting: Measurements of noise intensity and artificial lighting intensity (including emergency lighting).
Microclimate and ventilation: Comprehensive assessment of the microclimate (cold, moderate, hot) and verification of the effectiveness of mechanical ventilation.
Vibrations: Testing of vibrations affecting the human body through the upper limbs and whole-body vibrations.
Chemical and dust analysis: Sampling and assessment of exposure to concentrations of chemical and dust factors at workstations.

blocks.text: At the client's request, we take over the obligation to maintain record cards of test and measurement results, ensuring their accuracy and keeping them up to date.
vAs one of the few, we have a Laser Safety Officer on our team, ensuring supervision over safe work with laser equipment.
We help you understand and implement currently applicable regulations and standards, eliminating the risk of interpretation errors during inspections.
